title: Safe callback lookups and stale-action handling
summary: Verify current gameplay after separating required lookups from optional missing/hidden object, tile and player-state lookups. Stale actions must reject safely and controls recover.
preparation: Use a disposable save with fog, owned/enemy heroes, multiple towns, a Town visitor, two meeting heroes and a neutral battle. Install and verify the exact candidate with the helper before recording results.
limitations: Mark unavailable removal/ownership scenarios Blocked with notes. Automated callback/server tests cover missing identities separately. CI does not establish hardware acceptance. Record non-Thor/editor coverage separately; the helper does not authorize merging.

checks.title: Adventure fog and current objects
checks.steps: Explore and pan/zoom both maps; browse and inspect markers; switch levels. Where practical remove/lose an object or change ownership and revisit its former location.
checks.expected: Fog remains concealed; only current authorized objects appear. Missing/hidden objects cause no crash, stale details or actionable old marker. Exploration restores current information.

checks.title: Hero, Town and Meeting actions
checks.steps: Navigate Hero/Town cards; manage armies/artifacts; transfer Town/visitor and Meeting armies, including redistribution; recruit, confirm a build and purchase a boat where available. Try rapid repeats and selection/window changes during pending input.
checks.expected: Legal requests complete once through native/server routes. Invalid or outdated input does not alter another object or show success; pending controls recover and authoritative armies/resources remain correct.

checks.title: Movement, selection and modal restoration
checks.steps: Select heroes/towns from lower lists; plan/confirm/cancel a route, Stop/Continue and end the turn. Open/dismiss Hero/Town, utility and confirmation dialogs.
checks.expected: Both displays track current ownership and availability. Visible parents restore with no stale row, held gesture, residual window or unintended action.

checks.title: Battle controller and neutral battle results
checks.steps: Navigate/attack with sticks/A, cycle melee approaches, use X/Y Wait/Defend, Auto start/stop, spells and cancellation. Finish a battle against neutral units and dismiss results.
checks.expected: Previews and legal actions agree; held releases do not leak between windows. Neutral battles handle absent player states and Adventure restores without crashes or stuck controls.

checks.title: Display, resume and upper input
checks.steps: Toggle/reconnect the lower display and background/resume during held/pending input in Adventure, Town/Meeting and Battle. Check upper touch/controller and lower-disabled single-display play.
checks.expected: One current lower presentation restores, old gestures clear, current controls recover and upper focus/touch/controller remain usable.
